scope: Real Raspberry Pi read-only MAVLink monitor receiving disarmed ArduCopter SITL telemetry over local UDP

observed.battery_path: SYS_STATUS received; voltage was 0.0 because the retained SITL fixture had no battery model configured

only_outbound_packets: Fixed MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL requests for SYS_STATUS, ATTITUDE and GLOBAL_POSITION_INT
limits: This proves a Pi-to-SITL telemetry interface, not physical UART or USB compatibility.
No arming, flight-mode, parameter-write, position-target, velocity-target or actuator command exists in this monitor.
Simulated telemetry does not qualify flight, recovery behavior or a real battery monitor.
